name: Field Permit to Work Agent
headline: No crew starts work on an unconfirmed isolation
summary: Give permit coordinators and authorized persons a drafted risk assessment, an isolation check against the live switching state, visible sign-off timing, crew acknowledgements, control room isolation confirmation, on-site acceptance checks, close-out reconciliation and archived audit trails, while every safety decision stays with authorized people.
capabilities: Checks each work request before a permit is raised
Drafts the risk assessment with hazards, controls and PPE
Confirms the isolation with the control room before the crew accepts
Reconciles close-out and rebuilds the signed audit trail
value: Isolation gaps are caught before a crew is briefed.
Permits are ready for planned start times more often.
Close-out is reconciled and safety trends are visible.
